messages:
Samir: FYI customer ACME reporting sudden 429s + p95 spike on their Dedicated pool. Ticket SUP-4821. Started ~09:02 UTC after a controlplane config push.

Maria: quick sample error/log?

Samir: paste from their request logs:
```
2026-03-12T09:02:15Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=429 pool_id=d-pool-17 route=tier:gold
2026-03-12T09:02:16Z WARN request_id=abc124 latency_ms=1200 pool_id=d-pool-17
```

Ashok: initial suspicion: routing attr normalization change in last merge. We switched header mapping to `tier_label` internally; if the controlplane no longer recognizes legacy `tier` header it can fall through to default route -> shared/cold pool -> hits stricter qps.

Elsa: I see a deploy-bot entry around 09:01:48 for `controlplane/header-normalize` v2.1.0.

Maria: can we repro locally quickly? Samir, any repro steps from customer?

Samir: yes, they sent this curl to mimic: 
```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Tier: gold" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}' -v
```
They said after the push the same header suddenly routed to d-pool-17 and got 429s.

Julian: can you grab the controlplane decision trace for request_id=abc123 (from trace-collector)? Need to see attribute mapping.

Samir: pasted shortened trace: 
```
decision: evaluate route policies
attrs: { "headers": {"x-redwood-tier": "gold"}, "tier_label": null }
policy eval: tier_label match -> no match
fallthrough -> default_route: standard -> pool coldshared-pool-3
```

Ashok: that confirms it. The normalization changed so `x-redwood-tier` is being lowercased and remapped to `tier_label`, but in the mapping code we accidentally drop `tier` when both keys exist or when legacy key present with different case. PR 4321 introduced a branch that prefers `tier_label` and ignores `tier` if casing mismatch occurs.

Julian: I'll prepare a rollback/hotfix. Patch will re-add backward-compatible precedence: accept `tier`, `x-redwood-tier`, `tier_label` in that order and preserve value if present.

deploy-bot: merged: controlplane/header-normalize-fix v2.1.1 -> starting canary rollout 10% at 09:04:00Z

Maria: noted. Replied to customer with repro steps + asked them to retry in ~5m after fix. Also asked for a few failing request IDs to validate.

Samir: customer retried at 09:07 and reports 429s largely gone, p95 back to ~120ms. They sent new sample: `request_id=abc200` now routed to d-pool-17 with success.

Ashok: root cause: header mapping regression in controlplane -> caused tier mismatch -> fallthrough to default pool -> unintended throttling.

Julian: follow-ups: ENG-1189 created for adding unit tests + e2e for header normalization across casing and legacy keys; add alert for route-fallthrough spikes and telemetry label when default_route is selected.

Elsa: will add a short postmortem blurb in #postmortems and link the jira.

Maria: thanks team. Closing the customer loop. :thumbsup: :eyes:
